---
title: Long captioned table breaks across pages
format: typst
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      ensurePdfTextPositions:
        - # The table is taller than a page. A breakable figure starts on
          # page 1 below the title; an unbreakable one moves whole to page 2
          # and its last rows run past the page bottom.
          - subject: "FIRSTROW_MARKER"
            relation: above
            object:
              role: Page
              page: 1
              edge: bottom
        - []
